target.statement: Estimation error of SubSearch on a synthetic SBM graph with n=200, K=2, Γ11=Γ22=0.65, Γ12=0.35, γ=0.3, reported as 0.05 (sum of absolute differences between true and estimated Γ).

compute.basis: Paper reports 14 minutes on a dual-core i5 with 8 GB RAM for the single-run experiment; on an 8-core laptop with code already available, the run should take similar or less time, plus install and data generation overhead.

title: SubSearch: Robust Estimation and Outlier Detection for Stochastic Block Models via Subgraph Search
